what_would_you_like_to_create_today: What would you like to create today?
line_drawing_to_image_description: Transform architectural sketches into detailed visualizations. Convert hand-drawn plans or digital outlines into realistic renderings while preserving original design intent.
text_to_image_description: Create architectural visualizations using descriptive text. Input your design concept, materials, and environment to generate high-quality images matching your vision.
image_to_image_description: Generate new architectural images inspired by your reference photo. Create variations with similar design language while exploring different styles and compositions.
upscaling_description: Increase resolution and enhance details of architectural images. Sharpen features and improve clarity without distortion, making visuals ready for presentation and printing.
edit_image_description: Make targeted modifications to architectural visualizations. Change materials, adjust lighting, or alter specific elements while maintaining overall image consistency.
elevation_description: Transform 2D elevation drawings into photorealistic visualizations. Upload your technical facade plans and let AI generate detailed architectural renderings with accurate materials and proportions.
custom_styles_description: Upload your own design styles and apply them to visualizations.
image_to_animation_description: Transform visualizations into dynamic, animated videos.
expand_image_borders_description: Expand images beyond their borders - with AI-generated, seamless context.
remove_objects_description: Intelligently remove unwanted objects - for perfect visualizations.
replace_objects_description: Swap objects, add elements, or modify parts of the image.
change_season_description: Transform the season of your visualization - from summer to winter.
change_time_of_day_description: Adjust the time of day to present different lighting conditions.
change_facade_colors_description: Create color variations for facades - automatically and in real-time.
optimize_quality_description: Optimize image quality and sharpness - for professional presentations.
